```{r}
#| label: descriptives

descriptive_stats <- arrest_over_crime |>
  dplyr::group_by(period) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    mean_arrests = mean(arrest) / n_years[as.character(period[1])],
    n_arrests = sum(arrest) / n_years[as.character(period[1])],
    mean_pct_black_latino_pop = mean(pct_black_latino, na.rm = TRUE),
  )

descriptive_stats_spec <- tibble::tribble(
  ~stat,                        ~label,                              ~accuracy, ~percent,
  "mean_arrests",                "Mean Arrests / Year",               1,         FALSE,
  "n_arrests",                   "N Arrests / Year",                  1,         FALSE,
  "mean_pct_black_latino_pop",   "Mean Black/Latino Population (%)",  0.1,       TRUE
)

descriptives <- stat_table(descriptive_stats, descriptive_stats_spec)

descriptives$table |>
  dplyr::rename(`PredPol Era (Before)` = pre, `DICFP Era (After)` = post) |>
  knitr::kable() |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position")) |>
  kableExtra::footnote(
    general = paste0(
      "PredPol era spans ", n_years["pre"], " years (", era_span["pre"], "); ",
      "DICFP era spans ", n_years["post"], " years (", era_span["post"], "). ",
      "Per-year figures are annualized totals divided by these spans."
    ),
    general_title = "Note.",
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE
  )

```

```{r}
#| label: methods-narrative-values
#| include: false

n_tract_periods_raw <- nrow(arrest_over_crime)
n_zero_arrest <- sum(arrest_over_crime$arrest == 0)
n_tract_periods <- scales::number(n_tract_periods_raw, big.mark = ",")
pct_zero_arrest <- scales::percent(n_zero_arrest / n_tract_periods_raw, accuracy = 1)
dispersion_ratio <- scales::number(
  var(arrest_over_crime$arrest) / mean(arrest_over_crime$arrest),
  accuracy = 1, big.mark = ","
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-yearly-arrests
#| fig-cap: "Citywide arrests by year"

yearly_arrests_raw <- readRDS(here::here("data", "processed", "lapd-spatial.rds")) |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::mutate(incident_date = dplyr::coalesce(date_occ, arst_date)) |>
  dplyr::filter(type == "arrest", !is.na(incident_date)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    year = as.integer(format(incident_date, "%Y")),
    period = factor(period, levels = c("pre", "post"))
  ) |>
  dplyr::count(year, period, name = "arrests")

all_years <- seq(min(yearly_arrests_raw$year), max(yearly_arrests_raw$year))

yearly_arrests <- tidyr::expand_grid(year = all_years) |>
  dplyr::left_join(yearly_arrests_raw, by = "year") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    arrests = tidyr::replace_na(arrests, 0),
    period = forcats::fct_na_value_to_level(period, "no data")
  )

ggplot2::ggplot(
  yearly_arrests,
  ggplot2::aes(x = year, y = arrests, fill = period)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col() +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = all_years) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(pre = "#2c3e50", post = "#c98a2c", `no data` = "grey85"),
    labels = c(pre = "PredPol Era", post = "DICFP Era", `no data` = "No Data"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Arrests"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```
